telegram._comment: Credentials live in secrets.json (this machine) or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (GitHub Actions). Not here.

_comment_gates: HARD GATES. Any single failure = token is rejected, no alert. Loosen at your own risk.
_comment_momentum: max_price_change_h24_pct rejects tokens that already made their move - a clean token up 790% in a day is a safe way to buy the top. Set to null or 0 to disable the gate.
_comment_scoring: Tokens that clear every gate are scored 0-100. Only >= min_score_to_alert is sent.
_comment_social: Social weights derived from arXiv:2607.02823 (Cox HR 5.40 for Telegram presence, 8.94x graduation lift over 832,941 launches). X/Twitter is presence-only: x.com returns HTTP 200 even for nonexistent handles, so free verification is impossible.
_comment_composite: Final = safety_weight*on-chain safety + social_weight*social score. On-chain quality decides; social breaks ties. min_safety_score is a hard floor applied BEFORE the blend, so a weak-on-chain token cannot be carried in by a large chat room.
